title: @codelab/ng-dga component catalog entry
description: The metadata of one ng-dga component, kept beside it as src/lib/<name>/<selector>.catalog.json. scripts/generate-catalog.mjs turns every entry into docs/design/component-catalog.md, and tests/catalog.test.mjs keeps entries, components and the document in sync.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to this schema, for editor support.

selector.description: The element selector; also the file name stem (<selector>.catalog.json) and the /showcase anchor.

category.description: The catalog section the component is listed under.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the component is and when to use it.

inputs.description: Every signal input and signal model of the component, in declaration order.

outputs.description: Every output, plus the <model>Change events of two-way models when worth listing.

slots.description: Content projection slots; selector "default" is the unnamed <ng-content />.

a11y.description: The accessibility contract: roles, names, keyboard, focus and RTL behaviour.

since.description: The package version that first shipped the component in this shape.

default.description: The default as source text ("'primary'", "false", "null"); omit for a required input.
